messages:
nina (eng-security): Heads-up: scheduling a sanitized base-image rebase next Tue. Goal: remove unused setuid bits, tighten seccomp defaults, and rotate signing keys. Need infra + runtime coordination for a smooth rollout.

ben (eng-infra): OK. We'll provision a short-lived KMS grant for the signer SA and support dual-signing during transition. Propose a 3h JIT window.

zoe (eng-runtime): Admission controller change required to accept either old-key OR new-key during canary. Also run seccomp-strict canary on 5% of pools; flag CAP_SYS_ADMIN users now.

oncall (ops): Ops: several internal builders depend on loop mounts via setuid helper. If we remove the helper CI will fail. Ops can stand up a 48h privileged shim per runner with audit tags. Need a list of affected runners and owners.

nina (eng-security): Action list: 1) @ben open IAM PR with least-privilege + JIT TTL, 2) @zoe patch admission to accept dual sigs for canary, 3) ops list CI runners and request shims, 4) security will draft rollback steps and required audit fields (event_ts, signer.key_id, image.ref, image.digest, rebuild.id).

ben (eng-infra): RBAC example for runbook: 
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/signer \
  --member=serviceAccount:image-signer@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.signer
```

zoe (eng-runtime): Cosign dual-sign snippet for runbook: 
```
cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/old-signer gcr.io/redwood/base:rebased-2026
cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/new-signer gcr.io/redwood/base:rebased-2026
```

oncall (ops): Canary build queued: 7789001234-rebase-canary. Will monitor for seccomp violations and CI failures.

nina (eng-security): Please report any unexpected setuid usage by EOD. Preflight meeting 09:00 UTC Monday to review PRs and runbook.
